styleReference: Approved clear-adventure concept and current game artwork; interpreted as style guidance, not replacement game geometry.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single polished raster HUD action icon for a native/browser brick-building game. Style: premium miniature molded toy artwork, like the colorful dimensional inventory items in a clean LEGO-inspired adventure game HUD; restrained glossy plastic, clear bevel highlights, rich but controlled colors, soft natural occlusion, crisp silhouette. Isometric three-quarter view from slightly above, front facing lower-left, studio light from upper-left with soft fill. True transparent RGBA background: no backdrop, no floor plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no checkerboard, no surrounding UI. Square canvas. Center the complete object, filling about64% of canvas width and height with generous transparent margins. Designed to remain unmistakable when displayed at32 pixels. Favor simple bold masses over fiddly fine detail. No frame, no badge, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no extra objects. Subject: one friendly red toy motorbike with two chunky black wheels, compact bright-red body, a black saddle and simple black handlebars. Both wheels clearly visible; the silhouette must read motorbike immediately. No rider.
